test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following events did India NOT win any medal at the Summer Olympics 2020 (played in 2021)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women’s hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India **has **won **a meager **28 medals **at the **Olympics**.
 
• Not **quite impressive **for **a country **that **has regularly participated **in the **quadrennial event **starting from the **1920 Antwerp Games**.
 
• In **Women's hockey **events **India did not win any medals **at **the Summer Olympics 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **The Indian women's hockey team **won **the bronze medal **at **the Commonwealth Games **after they **beat Gold Coast 2018 champions New Zealand 2-1 **in the penalty shootout at the University of **Birmingham Hockey **and **Squash Centre**.
 
• **The Indian women's national field hockey team **(nicknamed **the Nabhvarna**) represents India in** international field hockey **and is **governed by Hockey India**.
 
• **Nabhvarna **is **currently ranked 6th in the FIH World Rankings **and is **ranked the best team in Asia**.
 
• They **won gold medals **at the **2002 Commonwealth Games **and the **1982 Asian Games**.
 
• They have **also won the Women's Asia Cup twice**, i.e. **in 2004 and 2017**.
 
• They also **won the Asian Champions Trophy in 2016**. India at the **2020 Summer Olympics**, for the **first time ever**, reached the **semi-final in the Women's Hockey Olympic **event but **failed to bag any medal after they lost to Argentina **in **the semi-final **and then to **Great Britain in the Bronze medal match**.
